counter_intuition.ordinary_explanation: This is the standard exact-discrete-Lagrangian or perfect-action construction for a generally covariant system, expressed as a history groupoid.
counter_intuition.braid_specific_input: The Braid source supplies the finite Palatini tower, one-plus-three primitive directions, reduced twelve-dimensional carrier, five-way refinement and strong source update convergence.
counter_intuition.strongest_boundary: The result proves existence and exact closure on the source-perfect refinement image. It is not an explicit local finite-cell formula and does not show that the unrenormalized raw cell action has exact finite HDA.
counter_intuition.falsifier: Failure of the regular stationary refinement limit, loss of the rank-four generator minor, failure of groupoid stationary composition, or failure of refinement intertwining on the declared branch.

claim_ceiling: Local regular source-perfect history-groupoid existence theorem with exact Noether identity, four first-class generator types, metric-dependent HDA Lie algebroid, BFV nilpotency, refinement intertwining and four-dimensional physical phase quotient. No explicit ultralocal raw finite action, global/strong-curvature theorem, empirical gravity, RPD adoption, Level 3 or Official SIEL status.
